name: nunchi-web
description: Nunchikochi web client (static). e2e runner only; the app itself needs no build.
comment: Playwright is not vendored. Install ad hoc (npx playwright) or point NODE_PATH at an install, then: npm run e2e. e2e:live needs a running service (scripts/run_local.sh) + a static server; set SVC/KEY/BASE.
